implemented_scope: All five verification jobs retain actual JUnit XML alongside original required reports/artifacts.
Pre-build fresh-checkout/source/output ownership journal; refuse historical unowned roots, source overlap, redirects, changed source/task, and overwritten receipts.
Always-run Gradle stop after eight build/test cycles, and again before exact final cleanup.

Primary upload outcome plus actual artifact ID/SHA256 required before deleting the last local evidence copy. Failed/cancelled/skipped/empty uploads preserve outputs and explicitly FAIL cleanup; no claim that hosted runner disposal is durable retention.
Final output cleanup restricted to claimed root/module/build-logic/Xcode-build/Python-cache directories; no global caches, source, or Store workflow edits.
Cleanup receipt is outside outputs and uploaded separately; leftover output list and strict failure status retained.
limitations: No successful local or CI execution exists for these proposed changes; root must run actionlint, focused filesystem tests, existing release validators, and actual cross-platform CI.

Exact directory cleanup and Gradle stop are not evidence that Kotlin compiler, Xcode/native workers, managed-device emulators, or CoreSimulator services stopped. Separately verify/repair those resource scopes before claiming full process hygiene.
All intermediate outputs are explicitly retained as one dependent same-job verification batch until the final artifact upload; no automatic per-cycle subset deletion is attempted.
GitHub may terminate the runner before always() cleanup during hard cancellation/timeout. Retention failure remains a failure, not a fabricated successful cleanup or durable external artifact.
No self-hosted/shared-runner guarantee or adversarial executing-PR sandbox is claimed. Current workflow uses isolated hosted runners.
Upload artifact paths span workspace and RUNNER_TEMP; resulting least-common-root archive paths may differ from older artifacts and must be inventoried rather than assumed.
cleanup: Draft/evidence generation only; no Gradle/Xcode/test process started, no generated build outputs created or deleted.
